research_object: A frozen five-card technique catalog with exactly one card per family, not the historical 11,590-card Top-k bank.

qualification_layers.pass_rule: No support-need packet source overlap; no raw response example is exposed to the generator; cards are technique-only.
Every frozen card passes clarity, use, non-use, fit, burden/risk, and safe-technique fields; confidence >= 3; approved for train-only pilot.
A transparent boundary/family gate selects one eligible card. Ineligible or no-benefit states map to R0.
Independent blind confirmation repeats a material quality-benefit direction and finds no added confirmed material risk for the promoted condition.
The frozen one-card injection fits the declared RS token/latency budget; equal-quality states map to R0.

open_rs_only_if: the treatment is actually injected and evaluable
there is sufficient probability of a material quality benefit
tie_policy: If the responses are materially equivalent, choose R0.

topk_policy.current_rs_catalog: Top-1 after family eligibility because there is exactly one qualified card per family.
topk_policy.future_topk_test: Requires at least three independently qualified cards in the same eligible family; otherwise Top-1 versus Top-3 confounds cardinality with card-bank quality.

llm_weak_audit_policy: Optional diagnostic only. An unqualified LLM judge cannot promote or veto a human-reviewed card.
claim_boundary: Passing this contract supports a minimum publishable train-only resource-allocation treatment; it does not establish clinical validity, universal card quality, or external generalization.
